description.zh: 经典扫雷游戏。翻开格子避开所有地雷：数字表示周围地雷数量，右键插旗标记可疑位置。提供初级 / 中级 / 高级三档难度，首点必安全，自动记录各难度最佳用时。
description.en: Classic minesweeper. Reveal cells and avoid every mine - numbers show how many mines surround each cell, right-click to flag suspects. Three difficulties, safe first click, best time saved for each.

controls.zh: 左键翻开格子，右键插旗 / 问号，点击已翻开的数字快速展开周围；触屏长按插旗，或开启插旗模式
controls.en: Left-click to reveal, right-click to flag / question-mark, click revealed numbers to chord open neighbors. Touch: long-press to flag or enable flag mode
